{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
sales_clean = sales[~(sales['revenue'] == 999999.99)]

# Now compute conversion rate by customer_segment across ALL orders (including refunded ones)
# Conversion rate = total converted / total orders
conversion_rates_all = sales_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rates by segment (including refunded orders):")
print(conversion_rates_all)

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates_all.idxmax()
print(f"Highest conversion rate segment: {best_segment}")"}
